# dsh-hooks-lite
中文

Lightweight, config-driven lifecycle hooks for DeepSeek Harness. Declare
`event → shell command` in

`cordis.patch.yml`; no plugin code, no client bundle,
no runtime dependencies.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## Why this exists

Claude Code and Codex popularized configuration-driven lifecycle hooks. DSH
already has the right se

ams — `tools/pre-execute`, `tools/post-execute`, and
`session/event` — but no small first-party-styl

re-execute`, `tools/post-execute`, and
`session/event` — but no small first-party-style hook plugin.
This plugin is deliberately the **small version** of that idea:

- **Host only.** No Web GUI, no approval flow, no client bundle.
- **Zero runtime dependencies.** Pu

re ESM + Node child processes.
- **Tool and session events.** Block before a tool call; observe afte

command gets a stable JSON payload on stdin and
`DSH_HOOK_*` environment variables.
- **Reloadable c

onfig.** Inline profile config plus optional
`$DSH_HOME/hooks.json`; `/hooks-reload` rereads the fil

fig.** Inline profile config plus optional
`$DSH_HOME/hooks.json`; `/hooks-reload` rereads the file.

It is not a compatibility layer for `.claude/settings.json`. If you need the
full multi-harness form

at, use a dedicated adapter; this one keeps the config
DSH-native and readable.

## Fields
| Field | Default | Meaning |

| `id` | auto `hook-N` | Stable hook id; must be unique |
| `on` | required | Event from the table a

bove (`event` is accepted as an alias) |
| `run` | required | Shell command (`command` is accepted a

s an alias) |
| `tools` | all tools | Exact tool names for tool events; ignored by session events |
| `match` | none | Field → regex; dotted paths work (`args.command`, `data.source.kind`). All fields

must match |
| `when` | none | `turn/end` reason or reasons |
| `timeoutMs` | `10000` | Per-run tim

wd; anything else is a path |

## Commands

- `/hooks` — configured hooks, config warnings, recent runs.
- `/hooks-reload` — reread `$DSH_HOME/h
ooks.json`; inline hooks remain.
## File config
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Default path: `$DSH_HOME/hooks.json`. Override with
`configFile` in the plugin row (relative paths r

esolve against `$DSH_HOME`).
Inline `config.hooks` is appended after file hooks.
## Safety

Hooks are **trusted host configuration**: commands run with the DSH host
process's permissions, not

inside the model's tool sandbox. Only enable hooks
you wrote or reviewed. A pre-tool hook can block

tool calls; post/session hooks
are fire-and-forget and never change model output.
